facts.statement: A single nearly-complete skeleton cataloged as IVPP V 18409 was discovered in 2009 in the Bayan Mandahu area of Inner Mongolia.
facts.quote: The fossils of Wulatelong, representing a single nearly-complete skeleton, now cataloged IVPP V 18409, were discovered in 2009 in the Bayan Mandahu area of Wulatehouqi, Inner Mongolia

facts.statement: The genus Wulatelong was formally described by Xu and colleagues in 2013.
facts.quote: Wulatelong was described by Xu et al. in 2013

facts.statement: The generic name Wulatelong combines the location of discovery, Wulate, with the Chinese word for dragon, long.
facts.quote: The generic name derives from Wulate, where the fossils were discovered, and long, the Chinese word for "dragon"

facts.statement: The genus Wulatelong contains only one known species, Wulatelong gobiensis.
facts.quote: It contains a single species, Wulatelong gobiensis

facts.statement: Wulatelong is a basal oviraptorid dinosaur found in the Late Cretaceous Wulansuhai Formation of Inner Mongolia, China.
facts.quote: Wulatelong is an extinct genus of basal oviraptorid dinosaur known from the Late Cretaceous Wulansuhai Formation (Campanian stage) of Bayan Mandahu, Linhe District of Inner Mongolia, northern China

facts.statement: Wulatelong lived between 75 and 71 million years ago during the Campanian stage of the Late Cretaceous.
facts.quote: que vivió durante el a finales del período Cretácico hace entre 75 a 71 millones de años durante el Campaniense

facts.statement: Oviraptorids, the group to which Wulatelong belongs, were bird-like theropods with toothless, parrot-like beaks and often elaborate crests.

facts.statement: Oviraptorids were bird-like theropods that were herbivorous and omnivorous, characterized by toothless beaks and often elaborate crests.

facts.statement: Wulatelong shared its habitat in Bayan Mandahu with ceratopsians like Protoceratops and Magnirostris, the ankylosaurian Pinacosaurus, and various other theropods.

facts.statement: Researchers concluded that the Bayan Mandahu fauna differs fundamentally from the classical Djadokhta fauna, possibly due to age differences or environmental factors.
facts.quote: Los autores del artículo que describe a Wulatelong concluyeron que la fauna de Bayan Mandahu "difiere fundamentalmente en su composición de la clásica fauna de Djadokhta, quizás por una diferencia de edad o por factores ambientales"

facts.statement: It is debated whether the difference between the Bayan Mandahu and Djadokhta faunas is due to age differences or environmental factors.
